flush_kv_cache: flush the SGLang server KV cache by sending a POST request to /flush_cache endpoint
run_flush_cache_cli: run the flush_cache CLI module with a target server URL argument
test_flush_cache_endpoint: test the /flush_cache endpoint on a running SGLang server instance
refactor_flush_cache_url: refactor the flush_cache CLI to support configurable server URL via argparse
review_flush_cache_script: review the flush_cache python CLI script that posts to a server flush endpoint
